summary: Phase 1J Performance Management — backend and frontend both GREEN. Backend: 24/24 pass (15 pre-existing phase1j + 9 NEW covering module-gating 402 on all 5 sub-routers + tenant isolation via reseller-created second company). Frontend verified end-to-end for HR (Overview w/ 4 stat cards + 3 tiles + Recent goals table, Cycles create+status-stepping, Goals create-with-2-KRs, Reviews Assign button, 9-Box grid renders 9 labelled boxes with Aisha Khan placed in Box 9 'Star — Future Leader', PIPs page with milestone Met/Missed buttons, Cmd-K shows HR-only 'Open review cycle' + 'Calibrate 9-Box') and for Employee (sidebar gated to only 'My Goals' + 'My Reviews', /app/performance/nine-box redirects to /app/employee, goals list shows only own goals, Cmd-K shows 'View my goals' and correctly hides HR-only actions). No critical bugs found.

minor.issue: One transient 404 observed in HR browser session on /app/performance/goals first load; subsequent reloads succeeded. Likely benign router hydration race; worth checking client-side fetch happens AFTER ModulesContext resolves performance entitlement.

integration_issues.flow: ModulesContext hydration after login (carry-over from iter 9/10)
integration_issues.issue: Still reproduces — HR must page.reload() after login for full sidebar to render. ModulesProvider mounts pre-auth, /api/modules/mine returns 401 → fallback active=['base_hrms'], and there is no useEffect dependency on the authenticated user. Perf sidebar items appear only after reload.

design_issues.screen: Multiple dialogs (CmdK, new-cycle, new-goal, place-9box, review)
issues: Radix DialogContent emits console errors/warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Screen-reader accessibility gap only; does not break functionality. Fix by adding <DialogTitle> (wrap in VisuallyHidden if no visual title) and aria-describedby.

action_items: (Carry-over from iter 9/10, STILL UNFIXED) Fix /app/frontend/src/context/ModulesContext.jsx — subscribe to useAuth() and refresh() when user transitions null→authenticated. 3-line patch: `const { user } = useAuth(); useEffect(() => { if (user) refresh(); }, [user?.id]);`
Accessibility: add <DialogTitle> (or VisuallyHidden-wrapped title) + aria-describedby on dialogs in Performance.jsx (cycle, goal, review, 9-box-place) and CmdK.jsx to silence Radix a11y warnings.

Seed / test-data hygiene: Phase 1J test fixtures are accumulating goals/PIPs/cycles on the live ACME tenant across runs (HR sees 9 goals, employee sees 27 goal-cards, 3+ 'Aisha Khan' PIP rows). Consider either prefixing test-created names with TEST_ and adding a teardown fixture, or running phase1j tests against an ephemeral company. Not blocking, but it pollutes the demo tenant over time.
critical_code_review_comments: Module gating is applied correctly on every Performance sub-router via requires_module('performance') — verified via 402 on 5/5 endpoints after /api/modules/company/{id}/disable. Good.

Tenant isolation is tight — cross-tenant reads blocked on /api/review-cycles (both directions) and /api/goals, and /api/nine-box?cycle_id=<other-tenant-cycle> returns empty placements. No company_id leak detected.
Duplicate review dedupe (cycle+subject+reviewer+type) works correctly, idempotent on repeated POST.
9-Box upsert semantics correct — second POST for same (cycle, employee) updates in place rather than creating a duplicate placement.

Performance.jsx is ~800+ lines holding 6 page components — consider splitting into PerformanceOverview.jsx / PerformanceCycles.jsx / PerformanceGoals.jsx / PerformanceReviews.jsx / PerformanceNineBox.jsx / PerformancePIPs.jsx for maintainability (File Size guideline in code_review_guidelines says >700 lines should be split).

Employee navigation to /app/performance/nine-box silently redirects to /app/employee (no toast/message). Acceptable but a small 'Not available for your role' toast would be nicer UX; backend correctly returns 403.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1J Performance module is fully functional. Reusable regression tests: /app/backend/tests/test_phase1j_performance.py (15 tests — cycles/goals/reviews/ninebox/pips CRUD+workflow) and /app/backend/tests/test_phase1j_gating_and_tenancy.py (9 tests — 402 gating + cross-tenant isolation). Route cheatsheet: cycles=/api/review-cycles, goals=/api/goals, reviews=/api/reviews, 9box=/api/nine-box (note hyphen, plural 'boxes' would be wrong), pips=/api/pips. Status transitions on cycles via POST /api/review-cycles/{id}/status with {status}. KR progress via POST /api/goals/{id}/kr-progress {kr_id, current}. PIP milestone flip via POST /api/pips/{id}/milestones/{mid}/status {status}. Reseller-created second company requires {name, slug, admin_email, admin_name, admin_password} — discovered during this run. Frontend performance pages live in /app/frontend/src/pages/Performance.jsx (single 800-line file with 6 sub-components). Employee sidebar correctly shows only 'My Goals' + 'My Reviews' because moduleRegistry.js filters perf items by role workspace. ModulesContext reload-after-login issue is still open (iter 9 bug).
rca of the issue: No new critical issues. The carry-over ModulesContext race from iter 9/10 has RCA unchanged: ModulesProvider mounts BEFORE user authenticates, /api/modules/mine returns 401, fallback sets active_modules=['base_hrms'], and there is no useEffect subscription to AuthContext.user to trigger refresh() after login. Mitigation during testing: page.reload(). Permanent fix: inside ModulesContext.jsx add `const { user } = useAuth(); useEffect(() => { if (user) refresh(); }, [user?.id]);`.
